blind.description: A medieval steel helmet resting atop a collapsed, crumpled pile of chainmail armor (hauberk) with visible folds and an open sleeve cuff. The surfaces are continuous, solid, and properly textured with metallic mail links and smooth brushed iron for the helmet dome. It sits flat on the floor with no plinth, and there are no hovering or disconnected pieces.
blind.from_above: A smooth round metallic dome surrounded by an irregular, textured, crumpled greyish-brown mail ring with protruding folds.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/5 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1 foot tall) and about 1.5 feet wide across the base.
